# Fictional test fixtures

Names, addresses, emails, amounts, folios and document contents are constructed solely for offline tests, not copied from user databases, real receipts or authenticated SII sessions. The owner-confirmed historical real identifiers are excluded from this candidate.

Some positive validation tests require generated numeric examples with valid RUT check digits. A valid checksum does not prove that a number was never issued in the real world. Never submit fixtures to SII, contact example addresses or use them as real identities. Synthetic test success does not validate live SII operations or tax-law compliance.
